messages:
emma (Docs): Hey team — PR #412's preview didn't show up in the Netlify deploy preview. The PR has an updated SDK snippet and a new migration guide. Can someone kick the preview or advise how to reproduce locally?
ci-bot: Netlify deployment failed for PR #412: build #298 — error: Missing ENV var DOCS_API_KEY. Link: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/298
liam (Eng): Netlify often misses the env if cache is busted. Try triggering a fresh build with "Clear cache and deploy" from Netlify UI, or re-run from GH comment: `@netlify rebuild` (if enabled).
noah (DevEx): To reproduce locally: `yarn workspace docs install && yarn workspace docs start` then open http://localhost:3000. For full build artifacts: `yarn workspace docs build && serve -s build -l 4000`.
emma (Docs): thanks — Netlify env looks fine though. The CI logs show the docs build step exits early with "failed to fetch remote plugin". Maybe a flaky network to the CDN.
liam (Eng): If it's the CDN plugin, we can pin the plugin version in package.json temporarily. Also I can rerun Netlify with cleared cache if you want.
olivia (PM): We want this merged by EOD if previews are green — feature team depends on the migration guide. Who's reviewing?
emma (Docs): @liam (Eng) and @noah (DevEx) please — I updated the SDK snippet and added a short example for Redwood Dedicated.
liam (Eng): I'll review after Netlify succeeds. If it still flakes, we can switch to Vercel preview for this PR — faster rebuilds for static sites.
noah (DevEx): Note: changing the snippet may trigger the docs snapshot tests. Run `yarn test docs --updateSnapshot` locally if you change examples. Also set `DOCS_PREVIEW=1` in env to enable preview-only assets.
emma (Docs): updated the snippet, pinned the plugin version, pushed a new commit. Can someone retrigger the preview?
ci-bot: Re-run requested by liam (Eng). Netlify deploy queued: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/301
ci-bot: Deploy succeeded for PR #412 — preview: https://deploy-preview-412--redwood-docs.netlify.app/ (sha: f9a8c3)
liam (Eng): Reviewed and LGTM. Merging in off-peak (will merge in 20m) to avoid build queue. :shipit:
emma (Docs): thanks! Will follow up with a tiny note in the release notes about the SDK example change.
olivia (PM): Awesome — tracking this in the release checklist. :tada:
noah (DevEx): For future: if Netlify keeps failing, let's add a CI job that runs `yarn workspace docs build` in GitHub Actions and uploads artifacts to the PR comment; quicker parity with local builds.
emma (Docs): noted. Closing the loop here — thanks all.
